headline: Your update now reaches your existing projects: the recent people-list fix — dropping stray contacts who showed up once but aren't really on a project — gets applied to your projects the moment you update, instead of waiting for the weekly cleanup. Plus a behind-the-scenes fix so updates from much older versions never skip a step.

items.notice_template: I refreshed the people lists on {n_rerendered} of your projects to drop stray contacts who showed up once but aren't really on the project — a correction from this update. Nothing for you to do.
items.fallback_prompt_template: A small refresh of your project people lists is pending from this update. It'll apply on its own at the next weekly cleanup.
